::: {.resource-hero}
## Learn a skill. Put it to work.

These concise field guides offer practical starting points for independent learning, research, and public communication. Each guide provides a core idea, a few habits to adopt, and a worked example. The separate **Practicing the Skills** module provides exercises and templates.

[Explore practice activities](practicing.qmd) {.resource-cta}
:::

## Apply what you learn

::: {.resource-feature}
### [Practicing the Skills](practicing.qmd)

Nine exercises, reflection prompts, and blank templates provide a place to try techniques on your own work. Activities are independent: start anywhere.
:::

## Who these resources are for

These guides are written for advanced undergraduate learners and early-career researchers working across environmental fields. They are not tied to a course, assignment, discipline, laboratory, or required software package.
